RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are men, meaning your sex was not a disadvantage relative to the candidate selected. An all-male panel choosing one man over another provides no basis for an allegation of sex discrimination, and raising it would undermine your professional credibility.

While an all-male panel may reflect broader institutional diversity concerns, it did not work against you in this competition. The hiring decision likely hinged on the hospital prioritizing management training and broad leadership experience over academic credentials. Instead of raising the panel’s gender composition, send a polite follow-up requesting constructive feedback to understand how to strengthen your executive and leadership profile for future roles.
